description.value: At the Water's Edge Adventures is a sea kayaking tour operator based at Telegraph Cove, BC, offering guided day trips and multi-day expeditions into Johnstone Strait, Blackfish Sound, and the Broughton Archipelago — some of Canada's richest marine wildlife habitat. Tours are fully nomadic and small-group, featuring orca, humpback, and minke whale encounters alongside Steller sea lions, dolphins, and bald eagles. In 2023 the company acquired Butterfly Tours, extending its reach to Haida Gwaii kayaking expeditions.
